title: 廢輪胎機械回收~Mechanical recycling of waste tires
focus: 輪胎複合材料解離、鋼絲纖維分離與膠粉品管~Tire-composite liberation, steel/fiber separation and rubber quality
summary: 以「輪胎複合材料解離、鋼絲纖維分離與膠粉品管」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。~Follow tire-composite liberation, steel/fiber separation and rubber quality through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

units.title: 複合材質清冊~Composite-material inventory
units.mechanism: 輪胎包含橡膠、鋼材與纖維等組分；用途與輪胎類型使比例改變，不應把整胎重量當膠重。~Tires contain rubber, steel and fiber; proportions vary by tire type and use, so whole-tire mass is not rubber mass.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：rubber input=1000*0.65；計算 1000*0.65 = 650 kg。適用限制：假想抽樣組成，不代表所有輪胎。~Original hypothetical teaching example: rubber input=1000*0.65; calculation 1000*0.65 = 650 kg. Applicability: Hypothetical sample composition, not all tires.
units.verify: 比較乘用胎與重型胎樣本的材質收支。~Compare material balances for passenger and heavy-duty tire samples.
units.failure: 以固定通用比例結算不同批次可能錯估產率。~A universal fixed composition can misstate yield across batches.
units.misconception: 每一種廢輪胎的橡膠比例都相同。~Every scrap tire has the same rubber fraction.
units.practice: 在「複合材質清冊」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 650 kg，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「以固定通用比例結算不同批次可能錯估產率。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for composite-material inventory, first reproduce 650 kg, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "A universal fixed composition can misstate yield across batches." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 粗碎切割與能耗~Primary cutting and energy
units.mechanism: 粗碎先降低尺寸並暴露鋼絲，能耗取決於進料、刀具狀態與粒徑目標。~Primary shredding reduces size and exposes steel; energy depends on feed, cutter condition and size target.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：specific energy=60kWh/2tonne；計算 60/2 = 30 kWh/tonne。適用限制：假想單段電耗，未含後段。~Original hypothetical teaching example: specific energy=60kWh/2tonne; calculation 60/2 = 30 kWh/tonne. Applicability: Hypothetical single-stage electricity; downstream excluded.
units.verify: 在相同進料量比較新舊刀具的電流與粒徑。~Compare current and size distributions for new and worn cutters at equal feed.
units.failure: 刀具鈍化可增加耗能而未提高解離。~Dull cutters can increase energy without better liberation.
units.misconception: 耗電越高就表示一定解離得越完全。~Higher electricity necessarily means better liberation.
units.practice: 在「粗碎切割與能耗」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 30 kWh/tonne，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「刀具鈍化可增加耗能而未提高解離。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for primary cutting and energy, first reproduce 30 kWh/tonne, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Dull cutters can increase energy without better liberation." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 解離程度與金屬回收~Liberation and metal recovery
units.mechanism: 磁選只容易捕捉已暴露或充分解離的鋼材；橡膠包覆會使混合團塊流向錯誤出口。~Magnetic separation works best on exposed or liberated steel; rubber-coated aggregates can report to the wrong outlet.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：steel recovery=180/200；計算 180/200 = 0.9 fraction。適用限制：假想已知鋼材進料。~Original hypothetical teaching example: steel recovery=180/200; calculation 180/200 = 0.9 fraction. Applicability: Hypothetical known steel input.
units.verify: 量測鋼材出口的附膠與膠料出口的殘鋼。~Measure attached rubber in steel and residual steel in rubber.
units.failure: 只量磁性出口總重會把附膠當鋼材回收。~Total magnetic-product mass counts attached rubber as recovered steel.
units.misconception: 磁鐵吸起的所有重量都是純鋼。~Everything lifted by a magnet is pure steel.
units.practice: 在「解離程度與金屬回收」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.9 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只量磁性出口總重會把附膠當鋼材回收。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for liberation and metal recovery, first reproduce 0.9 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Total magnetic-product mass counts attached rubber as recovered steel." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 循環負荷與再磨~Circulating load and regrinding
units.mechanism: 過大顆粒回到磨機形成循環負荷，設備處理量可遠大於新進料量。~Oversize returns create a circulating load, making mill throughput exceed fresh feed.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：mill flow=fresh/(1-return fraction);500/(1-0.25)；計算 500/(1-0.25) = 666.667 kg/h。適用限制：每循環固定25%返回，穩態無旁通。~Original hypothetical teaching example: mill flow=fresh/(1-return fraction);500/(1-0.25); calculation 500/(1-0.25) = 666.667 kg/h. Applicability: Fixed25% return each pass at steady state without bypass.
units.verify: 增加篩上返回比例並比較磨機實際負荷。~Increase oversize return and compare actual mill loading.
units.failure: 以新料量選設備會忽略再磨造成的額外負荷。~Sizing equipment from fresh feed ignores recirculating load.
units.misconception: 磨機處理量永遠等於新進料量。~Mill throughput always equals fresh feed.
units.practice: 在「循環負荷與再磨」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 666.667 kg/h，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「以新料量選設備會忽略再磨造成的額外負荷。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for circulating load and regrinding, first reproduce 666.667 kg/h, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Sizing equipment from fresh feed ignores recirculating load." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 環境溫度與低溫破碎比較~Ambient and cryogenic grinding comparison
units.mechanism: 低溫使橡膠變脆而改變破碎機制，但需另算冷卻來源與能耗；不以實機低溫設定作教學操作。~Cooling embrittles rubber and changes fracture, but cooling supply and energy must be counted separately; no live cryogenic setpoints are prescribed.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：sensible cooling=m cp DeltaT;100*1.5*80；計算 100*1.5*80 = 12000 kJ。適用限制：假想定比熱理論量，未含冷媒損失。~Original hypothetical teaching example: sensible cooling=m cp DeltaT;100*1.5*80; calculation 100*1.5*80 = 12000 kJ. Applicability: Hypothetical constant-heat-capacity duty, excluding coolant losses.
units.verify: 比較不同初溫下最低冷卻需求與最終粒形。~Compare minimum cooling duty and particle shape at different initial temperatures.
units.failure: 只比較磨機用電會漏算冷卻製備成本。~Mill electricity alone excludes cooling-supply costs.
units.misconception: 低溫磨機用電較少就代表整體能源一定較少。~Lower cryogenic mill electricity guarantees lower total energy.
units.practice: 在「環境溫度與低溫破碎比較」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 12000 kJ，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只比較磨機用電會漏算冷卻製備成本。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for ambient and cryogenic grinding comparison, first reproduce 12000 kJ, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Mill electricity alone excludes cooling-supply costs." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 纖維風選與終端速度~Fiber air classification and terminal velocity
units.mechanism: 風選利用形狀、密度與阻力差異；纖維不是球形，球形模型只提供尺度比較。~Air classification uses shape, density and drag differences; fibers are not spheres, so spherical models only compare scales.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：Stokes velocity=DeltaRho*g*d^2/(18mu);100*9.81*(0.00005**2)/(18*0.000018)；計算 100*9.81*(0.00005**2)/(18*0.000018) = 0.00756944 m/s。適用限制：僅低雷諾數球形假想粒子，不作實機風速建議。~Original hypothetical teaching example: Stokes velocity=DeltaRho*g*d^2/(18mu);100*9.81*(0.00005**2)/(18*0.000018); calculation 100*9.81*(0.00005**2)/(18*0.000018) = 0.00756944 m/s. Applicability: Low-Reynolds-number hypothetical sphere only; not a machine airspeed recommendation.
units.verify: 對照同質量球粒與纖維的沉降觀察。~Compare settling observations for equal-mass spheres and fibers.
units.failure: 把纖維當成同直徑球會錯估阻力和分選邊界。~Treating fiber as an equal-diameter sphere misestimates drag and separation.
units.misconception: 風選只取決於密度而與形狀無關。~Air classification depends only on density, not shape.
units.practice: 在「纖維風選與終端速度」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.00756944 m/s，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把纖維當成同直徑球會錯估阻力和分選邊界。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for fiber air classification and terminal velocity, first reproduce 0.00756944 m/s, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Treating fiber as an equal-diameter sphere misestimates drag and separation." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 產品粒徑級配~Product size distribution
units.mechanism: 不同用途要求不同粒徑與形態；篩分曲線比單一平均粒徑更能顯示過粗與過細尾端。~Applications require different sizes and shapes; a sieve curve reveals coarse and fine tails better than one mean size.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：fraction in target band=320/400；計算 320/400 = 0.8 fraction。適用限制：假想乾篩目標區間；不是通用產品規格。~Original hypothetical teaching example: fraction in target band=320/400; calculation 320/400 = 0.8 fraction. Applicability: Hypothetical dry-sieve target band; not a universal product specification.
units.verify: 繪出累積通過曲線並單列兩端質量。~Plot cumulative passing and report both tail masses.
units.failure: 平均尺寸相同的兩批仍可能有完全不同的細粉量。~Two batches with equal mean size may have very different fines.
units.misconception: 平均粒徑相同就代表級配相同。~Equal mean particle size means equal gradation.
units.practice: 在「產品粒徑級配」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.8 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「平均尺寸相同的兩批仍可能有完全不同的細粉量。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for product size distribution, first reproduce 0.8 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Two batches with equal mean size may have very different fines." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 殘留鋼絲與纖維品管~Residual steel and fiber quality control
units.mechanism: 膠粉中的鋼絲及纖維影響下游加工；代表性採樣與獨立確認比外觀判斷可靠。~Steel and fiber in crumb affect downstream processing; representative sampling and independent checks outperform appearance alone.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：steel contamination=0.08/400*1e6；計算 0.08/400*1e6 = 200 mg/kg。適用限制：假想質量檢驗，非安全或產品門檻。~Original hypothetical teaching example: steel contamination=0.08/400*1e6; calculation 0.08/400*1e6 = 200 mg/kg. Applicability: Hypothetical mass assay, not a safety or product threshold.
units.verify: 比較磁選前後及不同料堆位置的殘鋼。~Compare residual steel before/after magnets and across pile positions.
units.failure: 只檢查表面會漏掉料堆內分層的鋼絲。~Surface inspection misses steel segregated within the pile.
units.misconception: 膠粉看起來均勻就不需要雜質分析。~Uniform-looking crumb needs no contamination analysis.
units.practice: 在「殘留鋼絲與纖維品管」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 200 mg/kg，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只檢查表面會漏掉料堆內分層的鋼絲。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for residual steel and fiber quality control, first reproduce 200 mg/kg, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Surface inspection misses steel segregated within the pile." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 除塵質量收支~Dust-capture mass balance
units.mechanism: 碎磨粉塵須納入物料與暴露控制邊界；集塵量與排放量不同，捕集效率也不等同整套通風有效率。~Include grinding dust in material and exposure-control boundaries; collected mass differs from emissions and collector efficiency differs from whole-system effectiveness.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：collector residual=2*(1-0.98)；計算 2*(1-0.98) = 0.04 kg/h。適用限制：假想進入集塵器的粉塵，不含未被罩口捕集者。~Original hypothetical teaching example: collector residual=2*(1-0.98); calculation 2*(1-0.98) = 0.04 kg/h. Applicability: Hypothetical dust entering collector; uncaptured hood emissions excluded.
units.verify: 另列罩口逃逸量後重算總外逸。~Add hood bypass to recalculate total escape.
units.failure: 只報濾材效率會隱藏罩口漏捕。~Filter efficiency alone hides hood-capture losses.
units.misconception: 集塵器98%效率代表現場總粉塵必減少98%。~98% collector efficiency guarantees98% reduction of all site dust.
units.practice: 在「除塵質量收支」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.04 kg/h，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只報濾材效率會隱藏罩口漏捕。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for dust-capture mass balance, first reproduce 0.04 kg/h, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Filter efficiency alone hides hood-capture losses." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 用途驗證與全線收率~Application validation and whole-line yield
units.mechanism: 橡膠、鋼與纖維需分別追蹤去向，並依目標用途驗證性能與釋出；回收不代表任何場景都適用。~Track rubber, steel and fiber destinations separately and validate performance and release for the intended use; recycled does not mean universally suitable.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：rubber yield=520/650；計算 520/650 = 0.8 fraction of rubber input。適用限制：假想回收膠質量，不含鋼材副產物。~Original hypothetical teaching example: rubber yield=520/650; calculation 520/650 = 0.8 fraction of rubber input. Applicability: Hypothetical recovered rubber, excluding steel coproduct.
units.verify: 比較回收膠收率、總物料利用率及用途試驗三份證據。~Compare rubber yield, total material utilization and application-test evidence.
units.failure: 把副產鋼加到膠粉收率分子會混淆產品基準。~Adding steel coproduct to rubber yield mixes product bases.
units.misconception: 材料被回收後就不需再評估用途與環境條件。~Recycled materials need no further use or environmental assessment.
units.practice: 在「用途驗證與全線收率」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.8 fraction of rubber input，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把副產鋼加到膠粉收率分子會混淆產品基準。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for application validation and whole-line yield, first reproduce 0.8 fraction of rubber input, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Adding steel coproduct to rubber yield mixes product bases." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

history: 本課以來源所列的技術指引與研究為閱讀脈絡，並非重建某一設施的工程沿革；算例、數據與場景參數皆為原創教學假設。比較舊方法與感測、控制、資源回收整合的方法時，先固定處理功能及系統邊界，再評估效率與可靠度。~The cited technical guidance and research provide a reading pathway, not the engineering history of a particular facility. Examples, data and scene parameters are original teaching assumptions. When comparing conventional methods with integrated sensing, control and resource recovery, hold the treatment function and system boundary fixed before assessing efficiency and reliability.
